assumptions.statement: The AWS environments utilize Elastic Load Balancers (ELBs) that provide sufficient load balancing and cluster awareness to replace the local nginx proxy.
assumptions.quote: In the AWS environments these services are behind an ELB so this layer may no longer be required.

assumptions.statement: Testing has confirmed that removing the local proxy in AWS does not result in any degradation of service.
assumptions.quote: We've tested the instances in AWS without the local proxies and we have not discovered any degradation of service when using the ELBs.

assumptions.statement: The primary purpose of the proxy was to support client libraries that lack native cluster awareness or load balancing capabilities.
assumptions.quote: This is for the benefit of applications with client libraries that don't support native cluster awareness or load balancing.
